observed_original_abi.calling_convention_observation: ECX is the only register read: 0x00c0b9c0 is d9 81 bc 0b 00 00, FLD dword ptr [ECX + 0xbbc]. The encoding has no SIB byte, and the ModRM byte 81 gives mod=10 disp32 with reg=000, i.e. base ECX and disp32 0x00000bbc. There is no stack argument, no frame, and the next instruction is a bare RET, so the caller owns all stack cleanup.
observed_original_abi.return_semantics: The 32-bit IEEE-754 single at receiver+0xbbc, bit-for-bit unmodified, delivered on the x87 stack in ST(0). The body performs no arithmetic at all: it is a single 32-bit memory load.
observed_original_abi.return_observation: 0x00c0b9c0 FLD float ptr [ECX + 0xbbc] pushes the value; 0x00c0b9c6 RET returns with it still on the x87 stack because no FSTP exists in the body. Callers confirm the convention: 0x00c02dfe is followed by FLD float ptr [0x01687a10] and FCOMIP ST0,ST1, 0x00c22b76 by FSUBR float ptr [0x01687a00], and the parallel shape in 0x00b3e3e0 FSTPs into a stack local.
observed_original_abi.hidden_this_register: ECX, read once and never modified

observed_mechanics: 0x00c0b9c0: d9 81 bc 0b 00 00 - FLD dword ptr [ECX + 0xbbc]. The opcode pair d9 /r selects the 32-bit real push, the ModRM byte 81 gives mod=10 disp32 reg=000 (ECX), and the disp32 is 0x00000bbc.
0x00c0b9c6: c3 - RET. The absence of an immediate is what proves the callee pops zero stack words.
Live memory read at 0x00c0b9c0 returns d981bc0b0000c3cccccccccccccccccc, confirming both instructions and the nine-byte INT3 pad.
clang++ -m32 -O2 with __attribute__((thiscall)) emits d9 81 bc 0b 00 00 c3 for the reconstruction, byte-identical to the original seven bytes.
0x00c02dfe: CALL 0x00c0b9c0 followed by FLD float ptr [0x01687a10] and FCOMIP ST0,ST1, so the answer is compared against a tuning global without ever being spilled.

0x00c22b76: CALL 0x00c0b9c0 followed by FSUBR float ptr [0x01687a00]; 0x00c22bda the same followed by FLD float ptr [0x0158129c]. The answer is used as an additive and multiplicative term in a running x87 expression.
0x00c02e4e: CALL 0x00c0b9c0 followed by FLD float ptr [0x01687a0c] and FCOMIP ST0,ST1.
The body contains no conditional branch at all: there is no guard, no clamp and no default, so every one of the 31 callers receives the raw field value.

semantic_contract: Return the IEEE-754 single stored at receiver+0xbbc, unchanged, on the x87 stack. There is no guard, no clamp, no default, no arithmetic, no callee, no global read and no side effect of any kind: the entire observable contract is one 32-bit load. The receiver is not null-checked, so a null receiver faults. Every caller receives the raw field, which is why the comparisons against the tuning globals 0x01687a00, 0x01687a0c, 0x01687a10 and 0x01687a14 live in the callers rather than in this function.
classification_rationale: Not STRONG_SEMANTIC: the body is complete and the ABI, the offset, the return form and the byte-exact codegen are all established, but the owning class and the meaning of the field are not, and that is a material element under the batch definition. Not STRUCTURAL_ONLY: that would understate what is known, because the behavioural contract is fully determined - it is a pure accessor - and it is corroborated by five inspected callsites that pin the return convention. The bound is named: owning type and field meaning.
semantic_findings: The function is a pure field accessor, so the compiled bytes are identical under every x86-32 convention that can place the receiver in ECX; the observed uniform ECX usage across 31 direct call sites is what a non-inlined __thiscall const getter produces.

Every inspected consumer treats the value as a threshold in a comparison, never as an identity or a count. Three of them feed it straight into FCOMIP against a tuning global without spilling it, which is only possible because the value arrives on the x87 stack.
0x00c02df0 uses the same accessor twice against two different tuning globals to choose between three and two, so the field is a per-object parameter that shifts a classification threshold.

0x00c22ae0 uses the accessor three times and combines the answers with FSUBR, FMUL and FADDP against globals 0x01687a00, 0x01687a14, 0x0158129c and 0x013ec4d0, so in that caller the field acts as a bounded contribution to a weighted expression rather than a plain threshold.

The same object also carries a pointer at +0xb20 (read by 0x00c0b7a0 and by 0x00d2c018) and a sub-object at +0x5a8 (read by 0x00c22b19 and 0x00c02e28), so +0xbbc sits in a large aggregate of mixed scalars and sub-objects, not in a small settings struct.

The briefing recorded 17 callers; the live xref query returns 31 references, all UNCONDITIONAL_CALL, so four callsites at 0x00d760e7, 0x00d768eb, 0x00d77160 and 0x00d77234 were missing from the canonical table. None of them is a DATA reference, so the function still occupies no vtable slot.

There is no writer of +0xbbc anywhere in this batch, so the field is either initialised once by a constructor outside the inspected set or written by a function not reachable from the targets in this package.
unresolved_questions: What class owns this function? 31 live references, all UNCONDITIONAL_CALL, and no DATA reference, so it is not a vtable slot and no owner can be named.
What does the float at +0xbbc mean? The callers prove it is used as a threshold and as a bounded term in a weighted sum, but no SDK field, no global name and no string ties it to a game concept.
Who writes +0xbbc? No writer was found in this batch, so the field's lifecycle and default are unknown.

What are the four tuning globals 0x01687a00, 0x01687a0c, 0x01687a10 and 0x01687a14 that the callers compare against? They were never read by a tool in this batch, so no value is claimed for any of them.
Is 0x00c0b9c0 ever reached through a vtable at runtime even though no static DATA reference exists? A runtime patch or a dynamically built table would not show up statically and cannot be excluded.
What are the four unreported callsites at 0x00d760e7, 0x00d768eb, 0x00d77160 and 0x00d77234, which lie outside any Ghidra function body? Their surrounding code was not inspected.

What does the sibling accessor 0x00c0b8e0 read? It is called on the same receiver at 0x00ba27be and compared against 0x0156c198 and 0x0156c194, so it is a second parameter of the same kind, but its offset was not read.
